items.b: ANTWERP SENT OUT 1.15% FEWER POLISHED CARATS FOR 15.99% MORE DOLLARS
items.t: AWDC's July workbook, last saved 26 August and read directly by this desk, puts January-July polished exports at 1,581,439.42 carats for $4,217,580,162 against 1,599,866.76 carats for $3,636,115,968. That is $2,666.92 the carat against $2,272.76, up 17.34%. Rough exports went the other way: 10.90% more carats for 17.73% fewer dollars, $82.66 the carat against $111.43, down 25.82%.

items.b: A POLISHED CARAT OUT OF ANTWERP IS NOW WORTH 32.26 ROUGH ONES, FROM 20.40
items.t: The spread between the two ends of the trade widened by nearly twelve turns in a year. Antwerp imports polished at $1,897.93 a carat and exports it at $2,666.92, a mix difference of 40.52%. On rough the comparison inverts: in at $84.74, out at $82.66. The July month alone shows the polished gain down to 3.32%, so the surge is already fading.

items.b: DUBAI GIVES LAB-GROWN ITS OWN DESK, AND PUBLISHES A 43.86% PRICE FALL DOING IT
items.t: DMCC announced a standalone Lab-Grown Diamond Vertical on 30 August. Its 2025 figures show 76.9 million carats, up 91.5%, worth $1.3 billion, up 7.5%. Those two rates imply $16.91 the carat against $30.11 in 2024. Lab-grown is 21.39% of the carats Dubai handled last year and 3.12% of the dollars.

items.b: MICHAEL HILL'S PROFIT WENT FROM A$2.1 MILLION TO A$10.0 MILLION
items.t: The audited 52 weeks to 28 June carry the line July's trading update did not. Net debt fell from A$41.9 million to A$5.5 million, a reduction of 86.87%. Group sales were A$654.7 million, up 2.04%, on 281 stores from 287. Net margin is 1.53% against 0.33%. Rapaport reports revenue as A$655.7 million; the company's own figure is A$654.7 million.

items.b: THE ONLY PRICE ON THE STOLEN VIENNA NECKLACE WAS STRUCK IN DECEMBER 2015
items.t: A 1939 Van Cleef & Arpels piece of more than 200 carats across more than 600 stones was taken from the MAK on Thursday 29 August. The $4.3 million everyone is quoting is a Sotheby's New York result 10 years and 8 months old, about $21,500 a carat, on an average stone below 0.334 carats.

items.b: INDIA'S HALLMARK MAP REACHES 392 DISTRICTS IN 26 OF 36 STATES AND UNION TERRITORIES
items.t: The Third Amendment Order of 3 August adds 12 districts, from 380, including Panipat, Angul, Kancheepuram and Kotputli-Behror. Meanwhile the customs tariff value for gold holds at $1,500 per 10 grams against a metal now worth $1,429.04, a gap of $70.96 or 4.9656%, wider than Saturday's $67.88.
